prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, redesign] Sign In Visual Choice Cards Redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen to use visual choice cards for auth methods instead of standard action buttons.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "card", "headline": "Connect Your Pet Account", "body": "Choose your preferred sign-in method to keep your pet safely synced.", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "style": "rounded", "action": "choose"}]}}
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Companion Persona Quiz Screen: Insert a short interactive quiz screen right before choose_path to guide users toward preset vs custom pet creation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_persona_quiz", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "sign_in", "home_intro"], "new_persona_quiz": {"headline": "Find Your Ideal Companion Match", "body": "Answer two quick questions so we can recommend the best pet creation style for you.", "layout": "card"}}
2: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Compact Card Layout: Redesign the pick_friend screen with a compact card layout and rounded companion selection elements.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Choose Your Companion", "body": "Select a pet to bring to your desktop desktop workspace.", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "style": "rounded", "action": "choose"}]}}
3: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Pet Drop Preview Flow: Rebuild the home_intro screen with an interactive pet preview component allowing users to drag and test their pet avatar.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "body": "Try dragging your pet across the screen to get comfortable with desktop interaction.", "components": [{"type": "preview", "asset": "asset:pet_preview", "style": "playful", "action": "next"}]}}
4: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Mascot Animation and Audio: Add an animated mascot and subtle chime audio cue to the waiting screen during pet creation.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "components": [{"type": "mascot", "style": "playful", "action": "play"}, {"type": "sound", "asset": "asset:waiting_chime", "style": "subtle"}]}}
5: [sign_in, copy] Account Cloud Backup Assurance Copy: Reframe the sign_in headline and body copy around protecting pet progress and cloud backup.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Protect Your Companion with Cloud Backup", "body": "Signing in automatically saves your pet memories, progress, and settings so you never lose them."}}
6: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Centered Layout Refresh: Switch the choose_path screen layout to centered framing to focus user attention on the two primary creation paths.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "How Would You Like to Create Your Pet?", "body": "Pick a ready-to-go companion preset or create a custom pet from your photos."}}
7: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Mascot Stamp Highlight: Add a visual certified companion badge and mascot animation to the adoption certificate screen.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Official Adoption Certificate", "body": "Your new desktop companion is officially registered and ready!", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Certified Companion", "style": "emphasis"}, {"type": "mascot", "style": "playful", "action": "play"}]}}
8: [home, notification] Background Generation Completion Sound Notification: Enable background audio completion chime when pet generation finishes on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "sound", "asset": "asset:ready_notification", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
9: [finish, hint] Home Intro Desktop Controls Hint Banner: Display a hint banner on the home_intro screen explaining how to access right-click companion settings.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Tip: Right-click your desktop companion anytime to open controls, hide, or talk to your pet."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns the sign-in screen using choice cards while preserving its function and onboarding rules.
Inserts a new persona quiz screen into onboarding without removing required steps or violating rules.
Updates the pick_friend layout to compact choice cards while preserving pet selection functionality.
Rebuilds home_intro with an interactive pet preview inside onboarding as allowed.
Adds mascot animation and chime audio to the waiting screen while retaining progress indication.
Updates sign-in copy to emphasize cloud backup while keeping sign-in functionality intact.
Refreshes choose_path layout and copy while clearly offering both adoption and custom creation paths.
Enhances the adoption certificate with a certified badge stamp and mascot animation.
Adds background notification sound and readiness setting to the waiting screen.
Adds an instructional hint banner to home_intro explaining desktop controls.
